meta.evidence_status: PROVISIONAL first cut (CALCULATION + ASSUMPTION); replaced by results/revH/tip_params.json after the H1 simulations
meta.note: All values referred to the ball tip unless stated. Nothing measured.

architecture_note: B = skid ring on the FIXED front sleeve carries the writing load; the refill carrier (nose inner) moves on a 2-axis flexure gimbal inside the handle. Provisional choice because (1) actuators carry only the refill spring and ball friction (0.13 N + 0.03 N) instead of N cos(theta) + friction (0.64 + 0.15 N at 1 N, 50 deg) for A, and (2) a pure 2-axis rotation moves the tip perpendicular to the pen axis: a rigid nose (A) must push the tip into or out of the paper by delta cos(theta) for tilt-plane corrections (0.37 N of writing-force change per mm against the 575 N/m grip, CALC), while B's refill slides axially on its soft spring. A is being simulated for the comparison (model H1 with the grip-sleeve extension).

refill_axial_slide_mm.note: B: the refill slides axially by delta*cot(theta) (2.5 mm for 3 mm at 50 deg) plus the tilt-dependent protrusion change; constant-force spring F_c 0.15 N (P0 value)
refill_axial_slide_mm.label: CALC + ASSUMPTION

moving_mass_at_tip_g.label: CALC from assumed parts (nose tube 4 g, D1 refill 0.84 g, rear arm 1 g, 4 NdFeB magnets 4 g at z 80 mm)

suspension_stiffness_N_per_m.label: ASSUMPTION (laser-cut cross-strip gimbal, spring steel AMF-20 / BeCu AMF-18)

actuator.type: 2-axis moving-magnet voice coil (magnets on the nose's rear arm, coils and back iron in the handle)
actuator.label: ASSUMPTION: Km scaled from catalogue voice coils of similar volume (Moticont LVCM-016-013-01 0.85 N/sqrt(W), AMF-02; LVCM-016-010-01 0.82, AMF-73); peak 1.2 N and 0.35 W continuous per axis at the actuator (ASSUMPTION)

static_tip_load_N.bias: B: a fixed magnetic or spring bias cancels the 0.13 N refill-spring component (constant in the handle frame if the grip fixes the roll); A: bias spring plus slow zero-power trim (SQUIGGLE class, AMF-15) for N cos(theta) that varies with force and tilt
static_tip_load_N.label: CALC (1 N writing force, 50 deg, mu_ball 0.15, F_c 0.15 N; config values = ASSUMPTION)

servo.type: PID position loop on Hall sensing, 10 kHz inner rate
servo.label: ASSUMPTION (to be optimised)
